title: Enable task title/description editing and assignment from /tasks
description:
Implement end-to-end task editing in the Tasks workbench so users can update title, description, and assignee after quick-create.

Implementation plan:
1. API contract and validation
- Confirm `PUT /api/tasks/{idOrKey}` supports `title`, `description`, `assigneeMode`, `assigneeDirectoryId`, and `assigneeCustomText` updates in one request.
- Enforce existing assignee invariants server-side (`Directory` requires directory id; `Custom` requires custom text).
- Append clear activity events when assignment changes so history is auditable.

2. Tasks UI editing workflow
- Add an explicit `Edit` action in the detail pane that opens an edit form with current title/description values.
- Add assignee controls in the same form: mode selector (`Directory` or `Custom`), directory picker for directory mode, free-text field for custom mode.
- Add `Save` and `Cancel`; keep optimistic UI updates with server refresh on success.

3. UX and error handling
- Surface inline validation messages for invalid assignee combinations and empty required fields.
- Show success/error toasts and keep detail/history panes synchronized after save.

4. Tests and acceptance
- API tests: verify successful edits for title/description/assignment and validation failures for invalid assignee payloads.
- UI/integration tests: verify editing flow updates visible details and assignment chips without page reload.

Acceptance criteria:
- A quick-created task can be edited to update title and description.
- Assignee can be set or changed in both directory and custom modes.
- Task history shows the update and assignment change events.
- Invalid assignment combinations are blocked with clear errors.
